This repository contains reusable GitHub Copilot customisations for Microsoft Power Platform and related Azure development. These instructions describe this kit, not Kainos policy or the conventions of a consuming project.

- Keep repository-authored instructions and documentation in UK English.
- When a change affects this repository's purpose, customisation inventory, structure, or usage, update the relevant README.md in the same task. Do not update it for unrelated changes; keep its descriptions aligned with existing files.
- Keep examples clearly labelled as examples. Do not invent approved Kainos standards, Dataverse publisher prefixes, environment names, or other project values; use an explicit placeholder and ask for the real value when needed.
- Keep instruction sources consistent. Applicable repository, organisation, user, and file-scoped guidance can be combined; do not assume that one file overrides another based on its location or pattern specificity.
